observed_behavior: The retirement fixture assertion compared a protocol archive count parsed as LosslessNumber with native number 1 and failed despite the correct count.
expected_behavior: The assertion verifies the archive count without weakening the lossless protocol boundary.
causal_mechanism: The production native transport intentionally retains lossless numeric values; the fixture assertion assumed native numeric conversion.

anti_pattern.structural_description: Asserting native representation equality across an intentionally lossless serialization boundary.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: The same numeric token has different runtime representations, so equality fails independently of behavior.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Protocol assertions respect lossless numeric representation while checking the behavioral value.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Serialize the returned protocol result with lossless-json and compare its exact count token, preserving the transport parser.

applicability_conditions: The protocol parser preserves numeric values losslessly.
A fixture returns a count through that protocol.
confirmation_evidence: The failure showed actual count as LosslessNumber with value 1 and expected native number 1.
The passing retirement regression checks serialized count 1 and confirms archival occurred once.
regression_proofs: tests/rolling-campaign-store.integration.test.ts: worker retirement revokes native ownership and fences checkout release through restartable cleanup
